caption: The drawing is a black-and-white illustration of a stirrup, displayed at half its actual size, as indicated by the text "Stirrup (½ size)" written below the objects in a simple serif font. There are two views of the same stirrup: the left view shows an angled perspective highlighting the open central part and side holes, while the right view provides a direct front-facing angle that clearly presents the decorated surface. The stirrup is depicted with detailed line work and hatching to render texture and form, including multiple patterns such as wavy, zigzag, and dot motifs along its surfaces. Each view shows three circular holes on the upper part, and both sides are decorated with parallel lines and geometric motifs. The background is plain, unshaded, and a light beige color, emphasizing the monochrome line work without any additional colors or shading.
title: Wooden Stirrup
